author: Seung Wook
problem: Let f(x) = x^2 + 2x + 3. Read an integer t (0 to 10) and print f(f(f(t)+t) + f(f(t))).
bug_description: The outermost call to f is missing, so the program prints the inner argument f(f(t)+t)+f(f(t)) instead of f applied to it.

comments.accurate: Evaluates the nested expression f(f(f(t)+t) + f(f(t))) with f(x) = x^2 + 2x + 3
comments.wrong_behavior: Evaluates f(f(t)+t) + f(f(t)), the combined value of the two nested branches of f
comments.wrong_location: Nesting of the final expression verified; check the polynomial in f for the 2x term
